messages:
zoe (product): Quick sync — we need to land a plan for soft canaries across regions and how pinning interacts with latency SLAs. TL;DR: customers want regional pins + predictable p99 for GA. thoughts?

matt (eng-runtime): Are we assuming separate pinned replicas per region or a cross-region fallback?

ravi (eng-ml): Separate replicas preferred by customers for data locality. That doubles the resource commit for Dedicated lanes though.

sophia (customer-success): We have two enterprise customers asking to pin v2.1 in eu-west and ap-southeast only. They expect 100ms additional budget for cold starts but want steady p99.

anne (pm): Proposal: soft canary (2 weeks) with region-scoped pins enabled behind an opt-in flag. If region capacity < threshold, automatic fallback to global variant with a clear comms banner.

matt (eng-runtime): Implementation constraints: autoscaler treats pinned replicas as reserved capacity. We can expose a per-tenant "regional_pin_quota" but needs infra ops to commit GPUs.

infra-bot: Deploy queue status: no conflicts for canary stack in eu-west. ap-southeast quota check pending.

ravi (eng-ml): Benchmarks: for v2.1 we measured median token latency 70ms, p99 210ms on A100. With quantized variant p99 drops to 140ms but some quality regression on long prompts. Need a prompt-set eval.

sophia (customer-success): Customers will accept a quantized variant if we run their prompt samples and we can show <2% top-line accuracy regression. Can we make that part of the canary gating?

zoe (product): Gating checklist (draft):
- region capacity confirmed by infra ops (owners: matt, infra)
- per-customer prompt-set run and quality delta <= 2% (owner: ravi + cs)
- soft-canary telemetry for 2w (latency, errors, cost) (owner: anne)
- opt-in UX + comms + rollback path (owner: sophia + product)

matt (eng-runtime): Rollback path: set pin -> drain traffic via routing rules -> unpin and route to fallback model. We should add an emergency policy: automatic unpin if p99 > threshold for 30m.

ravi (eng-ml): Eval harness snippet we can run in CI:
```
run_eval --model v2.1-q4_8 --prompts customer_prompts.json --metrics latency,accuracy
```
We need to capture seed & prompt truncation policy.

sophia (customer-success): Ops for customer opt-in: we'll require an LOA (email consent) + canary start date. Also confirm what counts as "pinned" for billing.

anne (pm): Decision items for next week:
1) approve soft-canary gating checklist
2) infra capacity commit for eu-west and ap-southeast or set fallback policy
3) sign-off on eval pass threshold (ravi to propose exact metrics)

zoe (product): @matt @ravi can you confirm infra / eval feasibility by EOD Friday? If yes we'll schedule the canary kickoff next Tue.

matt (eng-runtime): Confirmed for eu-west. ap-southeast depends on quota approval, pinging infra ops.

ravi (eng-ml): I'll deliver prompt-set eval results and metric thresholds by Friday noon.

sophia (customer-success): I'll draft the customer opt-in template and LOA today.

zoe (product): Great. One more: do we want to treat pins as time-limited (TTL) for auto-unpin after 90 days unless renewed? quick vote :thumbsup: for yes

matt (eng-runtime): :thumbsup:

ravi (eng-ml): :thumbsup:

sophia (customer-success): :thumbsup:

zoe (product): OK locking TTL=90d draft. I'll write the runbook and comms, share for review. Thanks everyone.
